settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Metro cities: 2–4 business days. Rest of India: 4–7 business days. Every order ships within 24 hours on weekdays.

settings.question: Is delivery free?
settings.answer: Delivery is free on all prepaid orders. For Cash on Delivery, it’s free above ₹999 and ₹79 below that.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: You’ll get a tracking link on WhatsApp and email once it ships. You can also use the Track Order page with your order number.

settings.question: Can I change my address after ordering?
settings.answer: Yes, until the order is packed. Message us on WhatsApp with your order number as soon as possible.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: You can return or exchange within 7 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed and have tags attached.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Go to Track Order, enter your order number and tap “Return or exchange”. We’ll schedule a free pickup.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: Refunds reach your original payment method within 5–7 business days after the pickup is quality checked. COD refunds go to your bank or as store credit.

settings.question: How do your oversized tees fit?
settings.answer: Boxy with a dropped shoulder. Take your usual size for the intended oversized look, or size down for a closer fit.

settings.question: Will the print crack or fade?
settings.answer: We use high-density screen printing tested for 30+ washes. Wash inside out in cold water and skip the dryer for best results.

settings.question: Do the tees shrink?
settings.answer: Our cotton is pre-shrunk and bio-washed, so expect less than 3% shrinkage when washed cold.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: UPI, all major credit and debit cards, net banking, wallets and Cash on Delivery.

settings.question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
settings.answer: Yes, on most pincodes across India. Check yours on any product page.

settings.question: Are there extra charges for COD?
settings.answer: No COD fee. Delivery is free for COD orders above ₹999.
